```plato

    // The unit gradient of spatial lattice cell (ix, iy, iz): a uniform point on
    // the sphere, height sampled first (Archimedes' theorem) and the azimuth
    // taken from a second mix of the same hash.
    LatticeGradient3D(seed: Integer, ix: Integer, iy: Integer, iz: Integer): Vector3D {
        var h = LatticeHash(seed, ix, iy, iz);
        var z = HashToSigned(h);
        var r = (1.0 - z * z).Sqrt;
        var a = HashToUnit(NoiseMix(h)).Turns;
        return (r * a.Cos, r * a.Sin, z);
    }
```
